name: @javis-dog/collector-adapters
description: Pure platform adapters used by the javi collector (JD-C01), ADR-0016. S5b: Gemini CLI hook mapper, `gemini_cli.token.usage` allowlist parser, input-minus-cache delta rule and a dated Vertex AI price table for estimated cost. S5c: Codex CLI hook mapper, OTLP logs allowlist parser (`response.completed`, `codex.turn_cost`), cache-aware delta rule, cost for API-key auth only. S5d: agent self-report vocabulary (`SELF_REPORT`), strict validator, javi-tool matcher and hook mapper for all three CLIs, HMAC-seeded ULIDs (ADR-0017). No I/O.
